author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up (09/21/26): Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works. Contact: comment on the post or DM @blekek.k.

title: Hiring 2D Game Artist (Remote, contract)
content: Hiring 2D Game Artist (Remote). An indie game studio crafting polished, narrative-driven experiences with unique stories, mechanics, and immersive worlds, now seeking creative talent to shape memorable games. 2D Game Artist (Remote, Worldwide): Create concept art, characters, environments, and props. Requires a strong portfolio and proficiency in Photoshop, Procreate, Affinity, or GIMP. Unity and 3D knowledge preferred. Contract-based. Apply: Link in bio. Lead Id: 17917. Contact: apply via link in @creativeleadscommunity bio.
